verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an in-product AI that lets users ask questions in plain language and get answers across all their data, positioned as expert-level answers in seconds without SQL or building dashboards. This covers the core of AI-generated insights from your own data. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (as opposed to answers to user questions), in-depth documentation of how the AI insights feature works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
